lines.zh: 我在水晶峭壁上一步一停
lines.en: I step and stop along the crystal cliffs.

lines.zh: 长腿踩过尖棱，悄无声息
lines.en: Long legs cross the sharp edges in silence.

lines.zh: 水晶反光挡住了我的身形
lines.en: The crystal glare hides my shape.
I walk sideways along the rock face.

lines.zh: 每走几步就回头看一次
lines.en: Every few steps I look back.
I don't chase; I simply follow.
I shift my footing from edge to edge.

lines.zh: 峭壁的棱角硌得我脚疼
lines.en: These cliff edges hurt my feet.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但从不迷路
lines.en: I go slow, but I never lose my way.
Blue light slides off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 末地的静里只听见我的脚步
lines.en: Only my steps break the End's quiet.

lines.zh: 我绕开水晶拱生长的地方
lines.en: I skirt the spots where crystal arches grow.
I simply stand there, unmoving.
My breathing is faint, almost none.
My eyes are bright in the dark.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，还是没看见
lines.en: Did you see me, or didn't you?

lines.zh: 我在等峭壁再长高一点
lines.en: I'm waiting for the cliffs to grow a bit.

lines.zh: 站久了，水晶上都是我的影子
lines.en: Standing this long, I shadow the crystal.
I dislike being surrounded and stared at.

lines.zh: 别急，我还没想好动不动
lines.en: Hold on, I haven't decided to move.

lines.zh: 空气里有紫颂果的甜味
lines.en: The air carries a sweet chorus-fruit scent.
I tilt my head and listen a while.

lines.zh: 末地这么空，站着也不闷
lines.en: The End is so empty, standing isn't dull.

lines.zh: 我抬手理了理肩上的壳
lines.en: I brush the shell on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 又要开始追了，先歇一会儿
lines.en: Soon the stalking starts; let me rest.

lines.zh: 我数峭壁上闪了几次光
lines.en: I count how often the cliffs gleam.
At last you look up at me.
Hold still; let me see you.

lines.zh: 你身上有主世界的土味
lines.en: You smell of Overworld soil.
I stand half a body above you.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的是紫颂果吗
lines.en: Is that chorus fruit in your hand?
I don't eat people, but I do stare.
If you run, I'll follow.

lines.zh: 这么近，你可以摸一下壳
lines.en: This close, you may touch my shell.
Your breathing has gone uneven.
I've been standing here a long while.

lines.zh: 别拿剑指我，我还没生气
lines.en: Don't point that blade; I'm not angry yet.
The crystal is mirrored in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁也不先说话
lines.en: We stare, neither speaking first.
Turn first, and then I'll move.

lines.zh: 你把背留给我，这很冒险
lines.en: You leave me your back; that's risky.
I'm only curious, not hostile.

lines.zh: 峭壁上的风把我们隔开
lines.en: The cliff wind stands between us.
Keep looking, and you may regret it.
I was actually touched.
That one landed hard enough.
A crack runs through my shell.
I misjudged your strength.
It hurts, but I won't step back.
My blood is on the crystal.
You fight better than you look.
Give me a breath.
You hit off-center; I'm still standing.
I'll remember that blow.
Chorus fruit, isn't it?

lines.zh: 那股甜味是从你手上来的
lines.en: That sweetness comes from your hand.
I won't snatch it; I'll wait to be offered.
Eat it and I'll be calm a while.
You're holding it too high.
Even stretching my neck, I can't reach.
Is the fruit ripe?
I eat nothing else.
I take this step only for the fruit.

lines.zh: 你要是不给，我就自己拿
lines.en: If you won't offer, I'll take it myself.
Hit your shoulder; my apologies.
I'm too tall to watch my feet.
Move, I can't stop.
We both staggered from that.
Your armor scraped my shell.
I didn't mean to block your way.
The ledge is narrow; we must squeeze by.
That knock rang the crystal.
I'll step back; you go first.
Let's pretend it never happened.
Your shell shines brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这段峭壁吧
lines.en: Let's guard this stretch of cliff together.
Don't look at me that way.
I'll share half the chorus fruit.
Standing side by side is enough.

lines.zh: 峭壁会把我们的影子叠在一起
lines.en: The cliffs will stack our shadows.
Slow down; I'm not used to closeness.
Staying quiet like this is good.
When you leave, I'll follow.

lines.zh: 末地太大了，两个总比一个强
lines.en: The End is vast; two beat one.
Lift me? I'm not light.
Put me down; I can walk.
Your hand touched my shell.
Don't pull my long legs.
I dislike hanging in the air.
Hold firm; I'm heavier than I look.
Fine, just this stretch.
Where are you taking me?
The cliffs are getting farther away.

lines.zh: 我记着这条路，回去就靠它
lines.en: I'll remember this path to get back.
You stepped into my ground.
That counted as rudeness.
I've locked on to you now.
Stop. Don't back away.
I don't mind a long chase.
You land, and the crystal rings.
Now it's my turn to speak.

lines.zh: 峭壁上的每道棱我都熟
lines.en: I know every ridge of this cliff.
You can't outrun these long legs.

lines.zh: 我出手不会提前打招呼
lines.en: I won't announce my strike.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那片水晶，我要你赔
lines.en: You owe me for that shattered crystal.
Now you've genuinely annoyed me.

lines.zh: 我盯了很久，就等这一下
lines.en: I waited a long time for this moment.

lines.zh: 你的名字我不问，反正要倒
lines.en: No need for your name; you'll fall anyway.
The cliffs will finish what I start.
Run. The farther the better.
I'm always on your right.
You turn, and I step back half.

lines.zh: 别数我的脚步，数不清的
lines.en: Don't count my steps; they won't add up.

lines.zh: 水晶的反光在替你数时间
lines.en: The crystal's glare counts your time.
No rush — the cliff will pen you in for me.
I'm already ahead of you.
This path has one exit only.
Your shadow is trembling.
I don't shout, and I don't pant.
Ten more steps and my patience ends.
Listen, the cliffs are echoing.

lines.zh: 我离得很近，只是你看不见
lines.en: I'm very near; you just can't see me.
Don't look up; you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你身上的土味越来越淡了
lines.en: Your earthy smell is fading.
I strike on three.
There is no other way around.
I'm waiting for your mistake.
The End never hurries anyone; I do.
Try to block this!
My claws aren't long, but they'll do.
This one goes for your shoulder.
These three claw marks will remember for you.
Feel how hard the cliffs are?
I still have the next blow.
Take it and leave.
Don't expect me to stop.
Even the crystal rang.

lines.zh: 你的护甲救不了第二次
lines.en: Your armor won't save you twice.
I gave you a chance.

lines.zh: 我的长腿先到，爪子后到
lines.en: The legs arrive first, then the claws.
Hurt means you'll remember this cliff.
Wouldn't it be easier to fall quietly?
That one was polite.
I won't chase you past the cliffs.

lines.zh: 我从水晶的裂口里出来
lines.en: I come out of a crystal fissure.
One more shadow on the cliffs.
The End has grown a little quieter.
I open my eyes into a world of glare.
A new stalker stands up.
The crystal arches are slowly rising.

lines.zh: 这片峭壁从今天起归我
lines.en: These cliffs are mine from today.

lines.zh: 脚步声一响，你就该警觉
lines.en: When my steps start, be wary.

lines.zh: 我不急，末地的时间很多
lines.en: No hurry; the End has plenty of time.
I'm here; best not to look back.

lines.zh: 上面的末地塔比我想得高
lines.en: The End tower above is taller than I thought.

lines.zh: 光太亮，我眯了一会儿眼
lines.en: The glare is strong; I narrowed my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的壳还带着水晶的凉
lines.en: My shell still carries the crystal's chill.

lines.zh: 从裂缝到峭壁，我走了很久
lines.en: From the fissure to the cliff took a while.
New eyes, new prey.

lines.zh: 你们主世界的生物总爱乱走
lines.en: Your Overworld kind always wander.

lines.zh: 我还没饿，但已经想追了
lines.en: I'm not hungry, but I already want to chase.
The cliff wind knows me now.
The flame heats my shell red.

lines.zh: 从峭壁上摔下来，腿都麻了
lines.en: Falling from the cliff numbed my legs.
Brine seeps into my shell's seams.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻在峭壁上
lines.en: The blast threw me across the cliff.
That arrow is stuck in my shoulder.
The spell blurs my sight.
Too long without chorus fruit.
The bolt left my shell blackened.
The void drags at my long legs.
